Houthi fighters on Sunday said they used drones and missiles to attack a military base in southern Saudi Arabia as renewed fighting with Yemen’s government forces forced growing numbers of civilians to flee.

news.headline: Alexander Zverev vs Ben Shelton: US Open men’s singles final – all to know
news.summary: Ben Shelton faces Alexander Zverev in the US final, hoping to end a 23-year drought in Grand Slams for American men.

news.headline: Elena Rybakina defeats Aryna Sabalenka in US Open women’s singles final
news.summary: The cool Kazakh lifts the trophy after frustrating Sabalenka in a 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 win in New York as the new world No 1.
